Alger, 17 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 17, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Meta group announces the reinforcement of its existing paid subscriptions and the launch of new plans for individuals and professionals.
Extension des fonctionnalités pour Insta: Expansion of features for Instagram Plus, WhatsApp Plus, and Facebook Plus
Les formules payantes lancées en juin de: The paid plans launched last June are receiving significant upgrades. The Instagram Plus subscription now integrates the use of custom fonts for direct messages and Stories, the receipt of notifications when viewing Stories, as well as the display of direct message previews. Meanwhile, Facebook Plus offers extended customization options for Messenger, in-depth statistics regarding Reels, and the generalization of super reactions to feed posts and Reels.
Pour WhatsApp Plus, l'éditeur prévoit le: For WhatsApp Plus, the publisher plans to soon test two major new features: secure archiving of chats and media, and the implementation of group scheduling allowing conversations to be hidden or muted according to defined time slots. Meta specifies that some of these options will also be deployed on its smart glasses.
Grille tarifaire des abonnements particu: Pricing structure for individual and professional subscriptions
L'entreprise réaffirme par ailleurs que: The company also reaffirms that basic access to its applications as well as Meta AI features will remain free for all users.
Lancement de deux nouvelles offres pour: Launch of two new offers for individuals: Meta One Core and Meta One Premium.
Introduction de quatre formules professi: Introduction of four professional plans ranging from $14.99 to $499 per month.
Intégration d'outils de génération d'ima: Integration of image and video generation tools based on Muse models into the Meta One plans.
Maintien de la gratuité pour l'expérienc: Maintenance of free access for the basic application experience and Meta AI.
